statement: VAT taxable periods for a general taxpayer run January 1 to June 30 and July 1 to December 31 (Value-Added Tax Act Article 5(1)). The final return and payment for each taxable period are due within 25 days after the period ends, or within 25 days after the end of the month containing the closure date where the business closes (Article 49(1)); preliminary returns for each preliminary-return period are likewise due within 25 days after that period ends (Article 48(1)).
caveat: For individuals and decree-designated small corporations the tax office assesses 50 percent of the previous period’s tax instead of requiring a preliminary return (Article 48(3)); a new business’s first taxable period starts at the business start date or an earlier registration application (Article 5(2)).
